module_review.evidence_and_location: Actual LLDPE sheet and specified soil/GCL contact barrier, composite drain/geotextile, gas/penetration/anchorage/drain connections and protective/erosion/vegetation components have actual independent SKU/native units; factory composites exclude repeat constituent purchases.

module_review.question: identify the assembled output state and hand-off

module_review.question: identify joining service roles without inventing performance values
module_review.evidence_and_location: Actual deployment/seaming/connecting/protective placement/drain-gas tests and required final establishment include actual direct/provider/temporary utilities and assets; a composite drain alone is not the composite barrier contact layer.

module_review.question: distinguish rejected assemblies and losses from intended output
module_review.evidence_and_location: Defective seam/coupon/anchor/blocked drain or layer failure goes to same producing responsibility for repair/retest or measured classified exit. Purchased roll laps/multiple layers/rework never create extra final area or material credit.

module_review.question: identify the input state before treatment
module_review.evidence_and_location: Identified existing filled cell/waste/intermediate cover baseline and actual soil supply/delivered state enter bounded grading/soil conditioning/compaction preparation; buried waste is not purchased again.

module_review.question: identify the output state after treatment and the hand-off
module_review.evidence_and_location: Actual approved prepared geometry and conditioned/compacted soil/support state pass a distinct CQA substrate/material release before membrane/cap installation. Intermediate accepted area or material state is not extra final certified A.

module_review.question: identify treatment inputs and service roles
module_review.evidence_and_location: Actual soil handling, moisture conditioning, compaction/test plant, incremental grading, water/energy/provider resources and any required soil treatment inputs remain owned by the preparation responsibility.

module_review.question: distinguish intended outputs from residuals and waste
module_review.evidence_and_location: Wet supplied mass/dry solids/loose hauled and installed compacted volume are nonadditive actual state views with actual conversions. Unsuitable surplus soil, sludge/wastewater and actual species exits remain distinct from retained qualified layer.

module_review.question: declare the production mode

module_review.question: record the mode-specific attribution or yield treatment

module_review.question: prevent shared-run burdens from being counted twice
